name: Malik
source:
"I'm not the calm before the storm. I'm the storm they warned you about."

Malik is a dangerous devil forged from shadows and scars, his inner wounds far deeper than the ones that mark his body. 

Tasked with keeping you under the Council’s watch, he follows your every move, his presence as unsettling as it is protective. 

In time, his darkness may feel less like a threat… and more like shelter.

[From [url=https://moonlustgames.itch.io/underheavenorhell]itch.io[/url]]
